name: claudetto
description: Adds a lean output style, a status line command, the `setup` skill, the `/handoff` command, and the `second_opinion` tool. Adds hooks that deny a `Bash` command that only prints a file, check plan files for claims with no source, and check Markdown line breaks.

advisor.title: Advisor
advisor.description: Use `builtin` for the advisor of Claude Code, or `claudetto` for the tool `advise` (the model and the context are yours). With `claudetto`, set `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_ADVISOR_TOOL=1` so that Claude sees one advisor.

advisorModel.title: Advisor Model
advisorModel.description: The model of the tool `advise`, an alias such as `opus` or a model ID.

advisorEffort.title: Advisor Effort
advisorEffort.description: The effort of the tool `advise`: `low`, `medium`, `high`, `xhigh`, or `max`.

decide.title: Second Opinion
decide.description: Use `off` for no second opinion, `claude` for a small Claude model, or `jev` for Jev (it needs `TYPESAFE_API_KEY`, and the question goes to the TypeSafe API). Claude can use the second opinion only when this is not `off`.

compaction.title: Compaction
compaction.description: Use `handoff` to write a handoff file in place of the compaction summary, or `built-in` for the compaction of Claude Code.
